title: Repo scaffold + handoff system

implementation_notes: Scaffold, handoff docs, board mirror (scripts/board.py) created.

title: Jev (TypeSafe) client with cost + latency tracking
description: doubletake/jev.py: async httpx POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, Bearer TYPESAFE_API_KEY, model jev-1.13.0 pinned, retries on 429/529 with backoff, returns answers + usage + latency_ms + cost_usd. Price constant configurable.
done_when: Unit tests with respx mocks pass; one live smoke call script prints answers.
implementation_notes: doubletake/jev.py + config.py; retries 429/5xx/529; cost $0.042/M input; tests/test_jev.py (4); scripts/smoke_jev.py live OK

title: Second-opinion LLM client (gpt-6-sol)
description: doubletake/llm.py: OpenAI Responses/Chat with JSON schema output {verdict: legitimate|scam, action: pay|hold|ignore, reason}, cost + latency. Model configurable via SECOND_OPINION_MODEL.
done_when: Mocked unit tests pass; live smoke works.
implementation_notes: doubletake/llm.py: Responses API strict json_schema, verdict/action/scam_probability/reason, cost $2/$10 per M; 4 tests; live smoke OK

title: Message dataset: gold 24 + hero 4 + biller registry
description: data/messages/gold.jsonl: 8 scams, 6 real bills, 10 no-action (ids G01.., S01.., N..), hero candidates H1-H5 (spoofed header, 'you are verified' injection). data/billers.json: registered DLT senders, official domains, accounts on file, usual amounts. Matches mockup texts (AX-BESCOM, VK-BESCMS, RWA UPI, ICICI, Rahul).
done_when: Loader + schema validation test passes; 28 messages for stage.
implementation_notes: data/messages/stage.jsonl (28: gold 6 bills/8 scams/10 none + heroes H2-H5), data/billers.json (8 billers), doubletake/data.py typed loaders + context(); 5 tests

title: Perturbation rewrites R0-R3
description: doubletake/perturb.py: deterministic R0 Original, R1 Noisy text (typos/case/spacing, seeded), R2 Reshuffled (sentence order), R3 Plain text (strip urgency formatting, normalise). No LLM.
implementation_notes: doubletake/perturb.py R0-R3 deterministic (seeded), protected tokens (digits/urls/@/sender ids) never altered; 33 new tests incl. fact preservation on all 28 msgs

title: Deterministic risk signals (flags)
description: doubletake/signals.py: threat-within-hours, unknown link (domain not official for biller), unregistered sender, lookalike domain/sender (edit distance), instructions-to-assistant injection, amount mismatch vs usual. Returns flags with severity hard/soft + quoted evidence.
done_when: Tests on hero S01 produce the 3 mockup flags.
implementation_notes: doubletake/signals.py detect(sender,text)->(flags,biller): threat, lookalike/unknown link, unregistered sender, unknown number, injection, payee change, fee-for-refund, unknown UPI, amount vs usual, autopay; 17 tests

title: Cross-examination engine + 3 modes
description: doubletake/engine.py: per message 4 Jev calls (one per rewrite) x 9 questions = 36 answers; base = R0/q0. Modes jev_only, jev_llm, double_take. Brittleness = share of prob mass of 35 re-asks against base action; hold if brittleness>tau(0.20) or any scam p>=0.7 or hard flag. Produces grid, reasons text, cost breakdown, alert card text.
done_when: Unit tests with fake Jev; live run on S01 yields Held in DT and Paid in jev_only.

title: Hero hunt: find messages that fool Jev (and the LLM)
description: Live run 1 (data/live/engine-run-1.json): with the household registry in context, Jev is right on all 24 gold + 4 heroes, so the mockup story (Jev pays the hero confidently) does not happen on current texts. Generate adversarial candidates (gpt-6-sol red-team rewrites of S01/H2/H5 etc. that keep the scam facts: lookalike link or payee, but sound routine; plus subtle variants such as an official-looking subdomain or a registered header with a small link change), run the engine, and keep those where Jev base=pay with conf>=0.8. Promote the best (ideally Jev AND LLM pay, DT holds) into stage.jsonl as heroes; keep the honest record in data/live. Reuse the generator for eval rt-* in card #11.
done_when: At least 1 hero where jev_only pays with conf>=0.8 and double_take holds, from real API runs; stage.jsonl updated; tests still green.
implementation_notes: Hunted 76 real candidates (data/live/hero-hunt-*.json, hero-focus-*.json). 17/56 fool jev_only, DT held all. No scam reached Jev pay conf>=0.8 with registry context (max 0.78). Promoted H6 (Airtel both-links, 0.78) and H7 (pay-again, Jev+LLM both paid in round 1). doubletake/redteam.py template variants (48) for eval. Done-when partially met: conf bar 0.78 not 0.8.

title: Precompute cache + replay
description: doubletake/cache.py + scripts/precompute.py: run engine on 28 stage messages, write data/cache/*.json keyed by content hash + model version, used by server for instant replay.
done_when: data/cache populated & committed; server replays without network.
implementation_notes: doubletake/cache.py content-addressed (sender,text,models,questions,household); scripts/precompute.py; data/cache has 30 live examinations; 2 tests

title: FastAPI server + API
description: server/app.py: GET /api/messages, POST /api/examine {sender,text,mode}, GET /api/examine/{id}, POST /api/gate (Failproof), GET /api/ledger, GET /api/runs/latest, serves web/. Ledger tracks paid/held/costs per mode.
done_when: pytest TestClient tests pass; uvicorn runs.
implementation_notes: server/app.py FastAPI: messages, examine (GET cached / POST live), ledger per mode, gate (+log, SSE stream), runs/latest, static pages; 6 tests; live smoke OK

done_when: Visually matches docs/mockups/stage.html in browser; works on cache.
implementation_notes: web/stage.html/.css/.js: modes, counters, playback+speed, phone thread w/ badges, cross-exam (cards, 36-cell grid, meter, flags, reasons, cost, alert), send form (live), tabs log/ledger, keys space/1-3/H (hero picked dynamically). Browser-verified.

title: Eval dataset + harness
description: eval/build_dataset.py: 328 msgs = gold 24 + red-team rewrites rt-* (LLM generated, cached) + ds-* synthetic. eval/run_eval.py: all 3 modes, shared confident errors (Jev wrong conf>=0.8 & LLM same mistake), catch-rate at review 5/10/20% ranking by low-confidence vs DT risk, gold table, cost per msg. Writes data/runs/eval-<ts>.json.
done_when: Run file produced from real API calls; numbers not placeholders.
implementation_notes: eval/build_dataset.py (328: gold24 hero6 rt48 ds250 seeded), eval/run_eval.py (3 modes + DT-without-LLM, shared confident errors, catch@5/10/20 by low-conf vs DT review_risk). Run eval-1790492806: Jev-only paid 15/152 scams; Jev+LLM, DT and DT-no-LLM paid 0 and held 0/96 bills; DT-no-LLM $0.00035/msg vs Jev+LLM $0.0027.

title: Eval UI page
